statements.t: “Further, our Phase 3 ENSURE trials in relapsing MS continue to be on track to report top-line data in December 2026.

In parallel, the Phase 2 CALLIPER data along with the insights shared by leading MS experts at our two recent R&D Days support the rational for our Phase 3 PROTECT-MS trial in progressive MS, with initiation ongoing and first-patient-enrolled expected in the first half of 2027.”

The company’s lead investigational asset , vidofludimus calcium (IMU-838), is currently being evaluated in Phase 3 clinical trials in relapsing multiple sclerosis, with top-line data expected to be available in December 2026.
